Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Occupations Suggested vocabulary work, teacher, nurse, doctor, farmer, banker, s
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Occupations Suggested vocabulary work, teacher, nurse, doctor, farmer, banker, s in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to look at someone’s face as they speak to you?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Listen to the teacher/audio recording and identify words with the target letter- sound combinations: (‘sl’, ‘st’, ‘sw’, ‘sp’, ‘thr’). Learners with speech difficulties can identify orally, by typing or writing.

2. Pronounce words with the target letter-sound combinations, with peers. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication  Use words with the target letter- sound combinations to create

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Listen to the teacher/audio recording and identify words with the target letter- sound combinations: (‘sl’, ‘st’, ‘sw’, ‘sp’, ‘thr’). Learners with speech difficulties can identify orally, by typing or writing.
2. Pronounce words with the target letter-sound combinations, with peers. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication  Use words with the target letter- sound combinations to create

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Communication: The learner’s ability to listen keenly and actively is enhanced as they listen to oral texts, recognise words with

the target letter-sound combinations and pronounce the words correctly.

 Digital literacy: The learner’s ability to create with technology is enhanced as they role play different occupations and records

the videos.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to develop a talking tree using vocabulary learnt.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-awareness): The learner’s self-awareness is nurtured as they learn about different occupations.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to apply the attentive listening skills in learning of other concepts in other learning areas.
